title: Add a new kind of record where IDs come from a prefixed generator, and one older module does it differently
prompt: Add emoji reactions to comments, in a new src/reactions.ts: addReaction(store, commentId, emoji, userId) stores a reaction (with its own id) and returns it, and reactionsFor(store, commentId) lists a comment's reactions. A user can react with a given emoji only once per comment.
